title: U.S. attacks 3 Iranian oil tankers after missiles target Navy warships
summary_full: Three Iranian crude oil carriers were hit by U.S. forces on Saturday near Iran's key oil export hub, Kharg Island, in the Gulf, U.S. Central Command reported.
